pages.title: About
pages.html:
Quiet structure. Everyday movement.

Mode Atelier begins with the space between a city and the people moving through it. Clear lines, relaxed proportions and tactile materials form a wardrobe for changing hours.

Our first collection pairs architectural wool with light nylon, soft knitwear and considered accessories. Built around Seoul, imagined for a life in transit.

Mode Atelier is a fictional fashion brand created for this portfolio. Its products, imagery and editorial stories are synthetic; no goods are offered for sale.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.html:
Answers from the atelier.

Can I purchase these pieces?

This is a fictional fashion portfolio. Products and prices demonstrate the shopping journey; no physical goods are offered or fulfilled.

How do the pieces fit?

Read the fit note on each product and compare the example garment measurements in our Size Guide. The wool jacket has a relaxed shoulder and cropped length; trousers have a wide leg.

Which countries can I explore?

The demonstration includes Korea, Japan and the United States, with English, Korean and Japanese interface languages. Prices currently display in KRW.

What are the shipping and return options?

See Shipping & Returns for the proposed service flow and clearly marked test delivery rates.

Which payment methods can I use?

No real payment provider is connected. Checkout entry is available for testing; payment methods require merchant onboarding before a real launch.

pages.title: Shipping & Returns
pages.html:
Delivery, considered.

This page describes a proposed service flow for a fictional brand. No physical orders are fulfilled.

Demonstration delivery

Korea and Japan use a standard test rate of 5,000 KRW. Available destinations and rates appear at checkout. The United States retains the store’s initial demonstration rates. These rates are test configuration, not a carrier service agreement.

Proposed returns

An example launch policy would allow a return request within 14 days of delivery for unworn items with original labels. This example is not an active merchant policy and requires merchant and legal review before a real launch.

Client service

Use the Contact page to explore the enquiry form. Do not submit personal or payment information to this portfolio.

pages.title: Portfolio Privacy
pages.html:
Your information.

Mode Atelier is a fictional development-store portfolio. Avoid entering real contact, address or payment details in demonstration forms. Shopify hosts the storefront and checkout; its platform privacy controls remain in place.

This page is an explanatory portfolio notice, not a replacement for a merchant’s reviewed privacy policy. A real launch requires a data-processing review, retention rules, consent configuration and an approved privacy policy.
